title: The Deadline of Marseille's old port Revisited
author: Quentin Iversen
blurb: August Reyes, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
